_notes: Tunable wave-system parameters (SCRUM-90). Balance values come from the build document §4.4, §4.6 and §4.8 and are verified by tools/wave_sim.py (SCRUM-96); run it after every change. 0 means a placeholder still waiting for a balance value. Percentages are fractions (0.25 = 25 %). A file with the same name in Application.persistentDataPath overrides these values without a new build.

satisfaction._source: SCRUM-43, SCRUM-44; rating_thresholds are the 6 values listed in SCRUM-44, lowest first; patience_* are seconds of waiting (arrival -> seated)

rewards._source: SCRUM-45; one multiplier and one Energy amount per rating, same order as rating_thresholds

buildings._source: SCRUM-50; upgrade_prices[i] is the Coins price of upgrading from level i+1 to level i+2

sudden_rush._source: SCRUM-60; time_s is when the rush starts within the arrival phase

_waves_source: build document §4.8, 8 scripted waves; demand_total per need, 0 = need not in this wave
